Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this game. It was an easy win for Australia Women and with two strong victories, they are sitting pretty on top of the table in Group A. On Wednesday, 15th February, a couple of matches from Group B are lined up - India Women vs West Indies Women at 6.30 pm IST (1 pm GMT) and Pakistan Women vs Ireland Women at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). Do join us in advance for our build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women, says that they adjusted to the conditions really well. Adds that Georgia Wareham is a game-changer and it's nice to have her back after a long injury break. Mentions that it's nice to know that they will be playing in the same conditions for the next few games and shares that it was not easy to bat. Meg also praises Marufa Akter for the way she bowled and she feels that Akter seems ready to take the next step.

Nigar Sultana, the captain of Bangladesh Women, says that they failed to get enough runs in the Powerplay and that was one of the reasons. Mentions that it was a very good track and it's not easy to defend. Tells that if she bats for long, they get good runs and that's what she was trying to do. She praises for the way Marufa Akter bowled against some world-class batters. Nigar says that they are looking forward to playing good cricket against New Zealand Women and she wants her team to focus on batting. Thanks the fans for coming out in their support.

Georgia Wareham (4-0-20-3) is the Player of the Match! Says that it's very special to play for your country and to pick wickets that too in a World Cup. Shares that there was some spin on offer and hopes that it will start to spin more in future games. Adds that it's an honour to represent Australia and thanks the selectors for backing her. Tells that she is enjoying the atmosphere and the band at the stadium was really loud.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier, Bangladesh Women elected to field but their batting lacked intent. Apart from skipper Nigar Sultana, no other batter put up a fight and they managed just 107 on the board. The way they bowled, had they got a total close to 140-150, this game would have been very interesting.

It was a small chase for Australia Women and all they needed was one decent partnership. After losing Beth Mooney cheaply, Alyssa Healy and Meg Lanning formed that substantial stand and then the Australian skipper, along with Ashleigh Gardner saw her team over the line.

Easy win for Australia Women! They would have liked to finish the chase a lot earlier but credit goes to Bangladesh Women for bowling tidy lines and not letting Australia run away with the game.​ Marufa Akter was the standout bowler for them as she troubled the Australian top order with her pace and movement.
FOUR! Here are the winning runs! Flighted delivery, full and around leg, Ashleigh Gardner gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary. Australia Women win by 8 wickets.
Flatter and around off, Ashleigh Gardner gets back and punches it to short mid-wicket.
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Ashleigh Gardner tries to heave but misses.
Salma Khatun to bowl what could be the last over of this match.
FOUR! Two more needed now. Nahida Akter drags her length short, around off, Meg Lanning gets forward and then moves back before whacking it through point.
Too full and on off, it's knocked down to long on for a single.
A low full toss on off, Meg uses her feet and forces it down to long off for a run.
Shortish and on off, Meg Lanning hangs back and punches but finds the cover fielder.
Short and wide outside off, Meg cuts but finds point.
Takes a step down the track and lofts it down to long on for a run. 100 up!
Play and a miss! On a length and outside off, holding its line, Meg Lanning is beaten as she tries to drive. Marufa Akter has bowled out. Lovely bowling from her.
Fullish and on off, shaping in, Ashleigh Gardner flicks it towards backward square leg for one. Under 10 needed now.
Fuller and outside off, Gardner drives it past the bowler to mid off. Dot.
Inswinging yorker, landing around off, Lanning digs it out to cover-point and steals a quick run.
Shortish and on off, shaping in, Gardner pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Two big hits away now!
FOUR! Marufa Akter serves it on a length and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner leans forward and drives it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
A half-tracker around off, Meg rocks back to cut but finds the fielder at point. Australia Women are taking it deep. 16 needed more.
Short and on off, turning in, Meg goes deep inside the crease and cracks it past cover-point for a couple.
Tossed up, around middle, defended back.
Slower through the air, short and around leg, Meg moves back and punches it to covers.
A touch short and on off, Ashleigh Gardner punches again, this time past the diving bowler to long on. Takes a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Ashleigh Gardner punches it to the right of the bowler who stops it with a dive.
Nahida Akter will look to bowl another tidy over.
Taps a length ball to covers and scampers across for a quick run. A tidy over. 19 needed more.
On a length and outside off, Gardner drives square of the wicket but finds point.
Puts it on a fuller length around off, Ashleigh Gardner drives it off the front foot to covers.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it to mid off.
Full and around off, swinging in, Meg leans across and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Marufa Akter returns to bowl her third over. She serves a full ball down the leg side, Gardner tries to flick but gets a faint tickle. It rolls away to short fine leg and they cross.
Loopy and full, around off and spinning in, Ashleigh Gardner plays it from the inner half and it goes to long on. They cross. Australia Women are doing it in singles. 22 needed more.
Short on off, Lanning rocks back and strokes it to deep cover for a run.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Ashleigh Gardner drives it down to long on for one.
Turning in from around off, shorter in length, Meg punches it to wide long off for a run.
Flighted and full, around off, Gardner gets back and eases it through mid on for a run.
Lands it short and outside off, Lanning hangs back and slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Beaten! Loopy and full, around off, Ashleigh Gardner leans forward to drive but it spins away a hint to beat the outside edge.
Short and on off, Meg goes back and forces it to deep cover for a run.
Fuller and on middle, knocked down to long on for one.
Ashleigh Gardner walks in to join Meg Lanning.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket against the run of play for Bangladesh Women and it's the maiden T20I wicket for Shorna Akter. Flatter and fuller, outside off, Alyssa Healy drills her drive through the line but fails to keep it down. It goes aerial and straight into the hands of Nigar Sultana who makes no mistake. 30 needed off 45 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Nigar Sultana b Shorna Akter

Commentary.Commentary: Full toss around middle, Meg takes a step down and hits it towards deep mid-wicket. Finds the fielder and hence only a run.
Very full and drifting around leg, Healy forces it down to long on for a single.
Floated delivery, around off, Healy takes it on the full and clubs it down to long on for a run.
Serves it short and wide outside off, Meg slaps it to deep cover for one.
Advances down the track and gets beaten in flight. Meg Lanning does well eventually to defend it to the off side.
Walks forward to a full ball and lofts it over covers for a single.
Fuller and on middle, it's driven off the front foot to covers.
Flighted around leg, spinning in, Alyssa walks forward and tries to flick but misses.
Rumana Ahmed is into the attack now. 35 needed off 54 balls.
Short and close to off, Meg rocks back to cut but gets a bottom edge.

FOUR! Misfield and it's a boundary. Flatter and shorter, around off, Meg Lanning goes on the back foot and packs a punch. The fielder at point gets a low bounce and it goes through her legs. The sweeper cover fielder tries to mop it up near the fence but misses.
Short and outside off, Meg Lanning cuts with the spin but finds point.
Floated and full, around leg, Meg fails to sweep and is hit on the pads. She is disappointed.
Short again, around off, Meg punches it towards sweeper cover for another brace.
Shorna delivers it short and on middle, Lanning goes on the back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for two runs.

Drinks break. At the halfway stage, Australia Women are comfortably placed in this chase. Alyssa Healy and Meg Lanning are doing it with ease and they need another 43 runs to close the game. It's a matter of when, not if.
Overpitched delivery in the middle-stump line, Meg has punched this back past the bowler for a single towards long on.
Fuller delivery on and around off, Healy drills this back past the bowler who gets some hand on this and saves a couple of runs at least for her side. The ball rolls away to long off for one.
Full and wide outside off, Healy has driven this straight towards the fielder at cover.
Fuller and on off, driven down to long off for a single.
This one just gripped into the surface and kept a bit low, Meg tackles this well as she pushes this back to the bowler.
Length delivery angling in towards the batter, Meg has punched this back towards the bowler.
Length dragged back a bit this time by Khatun, Meg has cut this towards the sweeper cover fielder for a single.
Fuller delivery down the leg, Healy shuffles and smashes this down the ground towards long on for a single.

Checking for the bump ball! The soft signal is not out. Flighted and around leg, Healy steps back before walking down the track and hits it towards the bowler. Fahima Khatun collects and gets excited. The umpires want to be sure and go upstairs. It's a bump ball, confirms the replay.
Tossed-up delivery just outside off, Meg has chipped this over the fielder at the cover region and they run a single here.
Fuller delivery on middle, Healy comes down the track and hit this towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Khatun gives this a bit more air and Healy defends this off the front foot for no run.
Fuller and around off, knocked down to long on for a single. A decent over from Moni.
Width on offer here. Short and wide outside off, Meg has smashed this towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller delivery in the middle-stump line, Healy has pushed this towards long on for yet another single.
Length delivery towards off, Meg has tucked this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on top of off, Meg has punched this through the gap at covers for a couple.
Length delivery bang on off, Meg has punched this back towards the bowler.
Ritu Moni comes into the attack.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Flighted delivery, full and outside off, Healy advances down the track and lofts it to the left of the long off fielder. She reacts well and puts in a dive too but the ball slips out and meets the fence.
Fuller delivery just outside off, Meg has chipped this inside-out over the extra cover fielder for a single.
Short and wide outside the off-stump line, Healy has slapped this away towards the sweeper cover for a single.
Length delivery flatter in trajectory, Healy gets undone by the pace of it as it hits her pads. Loud appeal but this was going down the leg side.
Tossed-up delivery around off, Healy has pushed this straight towards the fielder at cover.
Flighted delivery outside off, Meg has driven this towards sweeper cover for a single.
Powerplay is done and Australia Women are going along nicely. Fahima Khatun comes into the attack.
Full and around off, spinning away, Meg takes a step down the track and drives towards point. The fielder there dives and makes the stop.
Full and wide outside off, Meg has driven this towards cover for no run.
Fuller delivery on off, Meg has pushed this back towards the bowler.
Length delivery around off, Meg has cut this towards the fielder at point.
FOUR! Lovely footwork! Floated delivery, full and around off, Meg Lanning wears her skates and whips it over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter around off, punched to cover-point.
Nahida Akter to continue...
Goes on the back foot and punches it towards the bowler. 10 from the over, 68 needed more.
Flatter and full, spinning in, Lanning flicks it off the inner half to mid-wicket for  a single.
Pitches it up and outside off, Healy strokes it down to long off for a run.
FOUR! Alyssa Healy has found her range and is looking in a hurry now. Short delivery outside off, Healy goes on the back foot and whacks it through extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Loopy delivery, full and outside off, Alyssa Healy gives the charge and lofts it cleanly over mid on for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, Healy drives it down to mid on.
Salma Khatun gets a change of ends.
FOUR! Sublime! Loopy and full, landing around off and spinning away, Meg Lanning presses forward and crunches it through cover-point for a lovely boundary. 17 from the over!
Very full and on off, Healy drives it firmly down to long off and takes a single.
SIX! Bang! Nahida Akter tosses it up around off, fuller in length, Alyssa Healy skips down the track and powers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Short delivery outside off, Lanning cuts it with the spin to cover-point and rotates the strike.
Loopy around middle, Healy jumps down the track to take it on the full and forces it towards mid on for one.
Arm ball landing around middle, Meg gets back and helps it towards mid on for a run.
Flighted and full, down the leg side, Lanning goes down to sweep but misses. The keeper also fails to collect and the ball races behind. They take two runs. Three wides in total.
Nahida Akter comes into the attack.

Edged but safe! Full in length and outside off, Meg Lanning gets on the front foot to push at it but gets an outside edge. It doesn't carry to first slip and the fielder there only deflects it away. They cross.
Wide! Full and around leg, swinging down, Lanning tries to flick but misses.
Lands it full and around off, Meg Lanning leans forward and defends it with firm hands. It dribbles in the gap at cover-point and the Australian skipper gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
Full and around off, angling in, Meg defends it back in the direction of the bowler.
Meg Lanning walks in and joins Alyssa Healy.

OUT! CAUGHT! Marufa strikes and she deserved a wicket for bowling so well. Very full and around off, angling away, Mooney walks forward and tries to drive but edges it instead. It goes down low to Rumana Ahmed at first slip and she does well to grab it with both hands. They appeal and the finger is up. Early blow to Australia Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Fahima Khatun b Marufa Akter

Commentary.Commentary: Angling away from the batter, on a good length, Mooney cuts from the back fot but finds point.
Edgy! Marufa Akter serves it on a length, around off and gets it to shape back in, Alyssa Healy is squared up in her stance as she edges it down to third man for one.
Slightly short and around off, Healy hangs back and punches it down to long off for one.
Quicker through the air, short and outside off, Healy goes back and mistimes her punch back to the bowler.
Floated and full, outside off, Mooney drops it with gentle hands to covers and pinches a single.
Bowls it short and outside off, Beth gets back to cut but chops it down instead on the off side.
Very full and outside off, it's stroked down to long off for a run.
Loopy and full, drifting in around off, Mooney flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a single. Gets off the mark.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's Salma Khatun.
FOUR! Put away! Fuller in length around leg, Alyssa Healy walks down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Australia Women are away!
Beautiful delivery to beat the bat. She dishes it out on a length outside off and gets it straighten off the seam, Healy presses forward to defend but is beaten on the outside edge.
Movement into the batter. From a shortish length around off, Akter gets this one to curve back into the batter, Healy defends it from the back foot. Four dots.
Keeps it very full and around off, Healy drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
Angles a length delivery around off, Healy defends it near her front pad.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Alyssa Healy stays back to cut but fails to connect.
